Own-domain check: dolcevitabakerycafe.com resolves (200) but is an unbuilt Squarespace 'Coming Soon' parking page with zero content (title 'Coming Soon', no menu, no contact info, no confirmed ownership link to this business). Not treated as a real website or an email source.

Similarly a search summary claimed the Instagram handle '@dolcevitagnv' exists; direct query to the Instagram web_profile_info API for that exact username returned 404 (account does not exist). Not used.
Conclusion: no public email verifiable from a source whose raw content was directly inspected. Outreach will rely on phone (call) as the manual channel.

Tried direct web_profile_info API lookups for plausible handles (dolcevitagnv, dolcevitabakerycafe, dolcevitabakerygnv, dolcevitagainesville, dolcevita_gnv, dolcevitabakerycafegnv, dolce_vita_bakery_cafe, dolcevitacafegnv, dolcevitabakerycafegainesville, dolce.vita.gnv): dolcevitagnv/dolcevitabakerycafe/dolcevitagainesville/dolcevita_gnv/dolcevitabakerycafegnv returned 404 (do not exist); dolcevitabakery returned 200 but is 'Dolce Vita' bakery in Canada (external_url dolcevitabakery.ca, 148 followers) -- a different business, discarded; several others (dolcevitabakerygnv, dolce_vita_bakery_cafe, dolcevitacafegnv, dolcevitabakerycafegainesville) hit Instagram rate limiting (401 'please wait') before a clean answer could be confirmed, so a residual small chance one of those is real cannot be fully ruled out, but none could be verified. An Instagram location page (instagram.com/explore/locations/122194483/dolce-vita-bakery-cafe/) exists (people have geotagged posts there) but does not reveal an owning business account. Left null rather than guessing.

Visit Gainesville's listing likewise only links the Facebook page. Tried dolcevitabakerycafe.com (resolves 200 but is an empty unbuilt Squarespace 'Coming Soon' placeholder, no real content), dolcevitabakerycafegainesville.com, dolcevitagainesville.com, dolcevitabakerycafe.net, dolcevitagnv.com, dolcevitabakerycafegnv.com, dolce-vita-bakery-cafe.com (all fail to resolve/connect). No functioning own website found.
own_site_note: dolcevitabakerycafe.com is registered and resolves but only shows an unbuilt Squarespace 'Coming Soon' parking page (no menu, no content, no verifiable link to this specific business) -- functionally equivalent to no website, but worth knowing the domain is not available for a from-scratch registration if this business is ever approached about owning it.
booking_note: Walk-in bakery/cafe with a physical counter and display case. No online booking or ordering platform found anywhere (no Booksy/Square/Toast/ChowNow links on any listing). Custom cakes and catering are arranged by phone per multiple reviews (e.g. Yelp reviewer Leah A.: cronuts reserved 'by calling them on Saturday'; Pam B.: 'She offers Italian dinners to go also', met the owner Rose in person).

rating_primary_source: Google Business Profile rating/count as mirrored by overlookmaps.com (4.5 / 156), chosen as primary because it reflects Google directly (per PIPELINE.md's Google-first sourcing) and matches the figure flagged in discovery. Yelp (4.5/126) and TripAdvisor (4.5/31) are consistent on the 4.5 rating, which is the figure actually surfaced on-site alongside the Google review count.
hours_source: netwaiter.com listing and general search aggregation for Sat 7:30am-3pm; bestcafes.online (raw HTML work-hours block) and yellowpages.com instead show Saturday closing at 5:00pm. Weekday hours (Tue-Fri 7:00am-5:00pm, closed Mon/Sun) are consistent across every source.
hours_note: Closed Sunday and Monday, consistent everywhere. Saturday closing time conflicts between sources (3:00pm per netwaiter.com vs 5:00pm per bestcafes.online/yellowpages.com); used 3:00pm (netwaiter + general aggregation) as the more frequently cited value. Also note a Yelp reviewer (DJ Tate) reported the doors being locked before the posted 3pm close on a Saturday, so real hours may run a little unpredictable depending on how fast the day's baking sells out -- consistent with several reviewers noting they 'run out of most items within the first hour of opening' (Noah M.).
owner_source: Yelp reviewer Pam B. (via bestcafes.online aggregator, review dated 14 July 2026): 'Everything is made from scratch and it tastes like it. Owner Rose was a delight to meet.'

menu_items_verified.source: Cross-referenced across Visit Gainesville's official listing description, restaurantguru, Yelp/TripAdvisor photos of the actual in-store display case, and multiple independent Yelp reviews (via bestcafes.online). Every item below appears in at least two independent sources.
pastries_sweets: Cronuts -- fried, rolled in cinnamon sugar, Saturdays only (baked/filled version available other days)
savory_lunch: Sandwiches made to order on request, Boar's Head deli meats and cheeses
Lunch special: sandwich + side (chips or pasta salad) + drink + slice of cake, reported around $10 by a reviewer
cakes_catering: Custom cakes made to order for weddings, baby showers, graduations, birthdays and corporate events
Italian dinners to go (per owner Rose, via reviewer Pam B.)
menu_items_verified.prices_note: Real prices ARE visible in photographed in-store signage (e.g. a Yelp display-case photo shows Napoleons $4.49, Key Lime Pie $18.99, Cronuts $4.49, Lobster Tails $5.89, French Macaroons $1.89, Cheesecake by the slice $4.99, Chocolate/Strawberry Bread Pudding $7.99 each; a separate 2026 Yelp review states 'A Cronut is $3.49 each at the time of writing'; another review mentions a ~$10 lunch special). These numbers conflict with each other in places (photos are undated, prices likely changed over time) so they are NOT presented as a current, definitive price list on the site -- the site describes items and points people to ask/see prices in store instead of stating exact figures that could be stale by the time this demo is seen.

reviews_verbatim_full.author: Jessica Lupinacci
reviews_verbatim_full.body: The pastries really are phenomenal. I would go as far to say they rival any Italian bakery on Arthur Avenue in the Bronx.
reviews_verbatim_full.source: Google (recovered via restaurantguru.com aggregator), ~3 months old as of the scrape

reviews_verbatim_full.author: Will Griswold Cheatham
reviews_verbatim_full.body: Amazing as always. If u haven't been here ur missing out. Had a key lime pie a week ago best pie I ever had.

reviews_verbatim_full.author: Pam B.
reviews_verbatim_full.body: First time here, great chocolate chunk cookies.  Eclair, cronut were delicious.  Pastry of cherry and apple was flaky and good.  Ordered pumpkin pie for today, great flavor and the crust was so good.  Everything is made from scratch and it tastes like it.  Owner Rose was a delight to meet.  Just wish I'd been here sooner.  Lunchtime has boars head meats.  She offers Italian dinners to go also.  Will be back soon.
reviews_verbatim_full.excerpt_used: Everything is made from scratch and it tastes like it. Owner Rose was a delight to meet.

reviews_verbatim_full.author: Noah M.
reviews_verbatim_full.body: I really like this place. They have some great pastries and run out of most items within the first hour of opening. This place would easily be a 5 star if they smiled a bit. T it's probably because they're up so early making pastries and don't have many staff. Still a hidden gem and my favorite bakery in Gainesville.
reviews_verbatim_full.excerpt_used: I really like this place. They have some great pastries and run out of most items within the first hour of opening.

reviews_verbatim_full.author: Laur R.
reviews_verbatim_full.body: I have passed by Dolce Vita on my way home from Possum Creek puppy park countless times, but had never found my way in until now. It is worth taking your puppy to as they have outside seating. If you are with someone else they have premade sandwiches and deserts in the cooler to try. Just send someone in to grab you something. I had the baked cronut with delicious Bavarian cream filling that felt so light and airy on my tongue. I was full from my sandwhich and pickle, but I could not stop eating that cronut. Dolce Vita Bakery is the only place in Florida to try a cronut. You will not regret it. Next time I will try the fried cronut with raspberry filling.
reviews_verbatim_full.note: Kept in research as extra color (outdoor seating, dog-friendly) but not used as an on-site quote to keep the testimonials section to 4 varied, concise voices.

reviews_verbatim_full.author: Anthony A.
reviews_verbatim_full.body: Was looking for a little sweet and found this small bakery on yelp. Dolce Vita is a tucked into a strip mall on 34 st. Small selection of cookies and pastries. We just grabbed two cannolis. They fill them to order. I'll say the filling was excellent. Nice mix of sweet and the Riccotta comes through just right.

reviews_verbatim_full.author: DJ Tate
reviews_verbatim_full.body: I was at the door at 1:56 (3 pm is posted) on 3/21/26 and the closed sign was up, doors locked.
reviews_verbatim_full.note: Negative review about early closing, kept only as context for the hours_note, not used as a testimonial.

brand_vibe: Warm, bright, European neighborhood bakery: lime-green and sunflower-yellow interior walls, glass display cases, hand-lettered 'Today's Special' whiteboard, striped serving trays. Photos lean warm cream/gold/berry-red rather than moody or dark, so the site uses a light, warm base (cream/butter background, espresso-brown ink, a warm red/berry accent pulled from the strawberries and cherry-topped pastries, plus a soft olive-green echo of the shop's own wall color).
notes: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5 / FORGE-BRIEF 0.b: walk-in bakery/cafe with no online booking. CTAs point to tel:+13525056688 and the Google Maps embed, never a fake 'book now' flow. No specific menu prices are asserted on the page itself (see menu_items_verified.prices_note) despite having photographed evidence, because the numbers conflict across undated photos; the site instead describes items honestly and invites visitors to see prices in store or call ahead for custom cakes, matching the reviewer-documented real ordering behavior (call-ahead for Saturday cronuts, call to arrange custom cakes/catering).
